the hinge region of human IgA1 contains two key residues that are absolutely required for cleavage by streptococal IgA1 proteas, and that these two residues can be replaced by valines.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the amino acid sequence requirements for cleavage by streptococcus IgA1 prote-ases are not uniform across the different streptococcus species and strains.
the hinge region of IgA1 is a target for bacterial protease attack and that this is a potential mechanism for bacterial immune evasion.
